page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. The virtual machine delivers 16 dedicated vCPUs sourced from 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem features 48 MB of L3 cache along with instruction set support for AVX-512 with VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI. System memory totals 60 GB, equating to 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU featuring 24 GB of GDDR6 VRAM. The server configuration includes no local disk storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes for all file system and persistent data needs. Network throughput is provisioned with a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

Benchmark data positions the instance's general-purpose CPU and memory performance within the middle 50 percent tier. PassMark tests yielded an overall CPU score of 21025.87, while Geekbench recorded a single-core score of 1584.0 and a multi-core score of 9350.0. In contrast, the dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPU achieves top-tier results in AI inference evaluations. Small 135M parameter models achieve prompt processing speeds of 9711.75 tokens per second and text generation speeds of 460.73 tokens per second, while 7B parameter models sustain 2480.56 tokens per second for prompts and 90.39 tokens per second for text generation.

From an infrastructure perspective, this instance offers resource efficiency for tasks requiring targeted GPU acceleration without the overhead of multi-GPU deployments. The primary tradeoff is the complete absence of local NVMe storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistence. The instance is suited for AI inference serving, video transcoding pipelines, ray tracing tasks, and cloud-based rendering workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c16g1.4xlarge is a compute-optimized, GPU-accelerated instance designed for AI inference, graphics processing, and compute-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz, it provides 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores alongside 60 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is delivered by a dedicated NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. Networking throughput features a 16 Gbps baseline, while no local disk storage is provided, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistence. In standardized benchmarks, general compute, memory throughput, and decompression metrics perform in the median 50 percent tier, whereas large language model inference shows top-tier throughput for small and medium parameter architectures. The configuration offers balanced cost efficiency for inference scenarios where single-card GPU resources align with moderate CPU and memory allocations, making it well matched for machine learning serving, video transcoding, and visual computing workloads.
